rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 95-100% dark melanin saturation; the rhinarium surface consists of low-luminance pixels with no clearly identifiable pink or pale depigmented regions at this resolution.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous small, dark, high-contrast focal points across the nasal bridge and frontal bone region, consistent with the presence of ectoparasites (flies) or localized superficial cutaneous marks.
